messages:
mira_cs: FYI CedarLine kicked off an APAC pilot today and immediately hit the per-minute throttle. They asked if we can open a short-lived CIDR exception and raise per-route burst to validate throughput.

emma_acct: Renewal flagged as medium risk if pilot stalls. They want a 10-day window to test from their staging CIDR, will consider 480 rps burst on /v1/chat for the pilot.

mira_cs: @kai_net can we allow their staging CIDRs: 203.0.113.64/28 and 198.51.100.0/26? They also request header match on X-Env:cedar-staging.

kai_net: Yep. Plan: add CIDRs to edge ipset, create a rate window with auto-revoke TTL=10d, and add header allow rule. Any global caps?

emma_acct: Keep global soft cap conservative — they only need capacity for the pilot. Suggest per-route burst 480, global soft 700.

devon_sre: @mira_cs tagging SRE review. I'll run a quick noisy-neighbor/cost impact scan. If we enable it, we'll also add an auto-fallback to a smaller model family to protect latency SLOs.

ops-bot: Preflight checks: no APAC incidents. Recommend KV prewarm for cedarline prefix and set p95 alert at 1500ms.

kai_net: Draft change snippet:

```
# CedarLine temp allowlist + rate window (auto-revoke 10d)
ipset add cedarline_203 203.0.113.64/28
ipset add cedarline_198 198.51.100.0/26
route /v1/chat burst=480 per_route_soft=480 global_soft=700 headers.allow=X-Env:cedar-staging
# tag: cedarline-pilot-3123469999
```

kai_net: I'll open JIRA INF-7410 and include the change. Mark rollback/auto-revoke for 2026-04-20.

mira_cs: Capture customer feedback: they saw 600ms median in us-west but 1.1s p95 in ap-southeast during spikes. They asked about region pin to ap-southeast-1 if we can show cost delta.

devon_sre: I can attach a routing policy for token-level pinning to ap-southeast-1. That will reduce cross-region RTT but increases egress/cost. Sending cost delta to @emma_acct for the quote.

emma_acct: Please draft the cost delta before we enable pin. We'll only enable after customer agrees. Also add a renewal note that CS provided a one-time pilot concession.

mira_cs: Scheduling enablement runbook with docs and product on Friday to validate prompts and monitor quality under load. Will capture any hallucination spikes that correlate with increased qps.

kai_net: Change queued pending SRE signoff. Adding webhook to auto-revoke the ipset after TTL.

devon_sre: Applied to staging, smoke tests green. Rolling to prod in 10. Alerts set: p95 > 1500ms triggers rollback and small-model fallback.

mira_cs: :thumbsup: ping me when live so i can notify CedarLine and set up the Friday session. Adding note to renewal tracker: "Pilot latency in APAC; concession granted".

kai_net: Live now. CIDRs allowed, rate window active, header match enforced. Watchlist created: cedarline-3123469999.

mira_cs: We'll review telemetry after 24h and capture sentiment + any quality regressions.

emma_acct: I'll prepare a usage+cost summary for day 8 and follow up on renewal outreach.

mira_cs: Thanks everyone."
